question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is **Subscrieb**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of '**Subscrieb**' according to the English dictionary is '**Subscribe**'.
 
• The word** 'subscribe**' means to agree with or support an opinion, theory, etc. or to pay for a newspaper or magazine to be sent to you regularly. (अभिदान करना,समर्थन करना,हस्ताक्षर करना)
 
 
• **Example**: I **subscribe **to the idea that voting is my civic duty.
 
 
 
• Hence, option 2 is correct.​​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​​Let's understand the meaning of other options.
 
 
• **Measure**- to find the size, weight, quantity, etc. of somebody/something in standard units by using an instrument.
 
• **Rectify**- to correct something that is wrong.
 
• **Branding**- the process of creating a distinct identity for a business in the mind of your target audience and consumers.
